synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours: walls 10 (H row + V col = most wall blocks), pieces 5, targets 11, reflections 4.
A5 cycles H->V->pieces (reading order of min block)->H; A1/A2 move H or piece, A3/A4 move V or piece; axes pass under pieces, pieces blocked by board edge and other pieces.
Every piece block mirrored across H, V and both as solid colour-4 blocks, clipped to board, not drawn on pieces.
Hole centre: target 11, else selected-axis dot 0 (also through unselected piece), else top fill; selection decided from wall 0-dots before piece 0-centres. HUD col 63 = one 12 per effective action.
Unconfirmed: piece touching H row hides its V mirror (never exercised), A6/A7 no-ops, piece-vs-axis blocking.
